Subject: Post-discussion: scheduling technical deep-dive + stakeholder loop

Alex — thanks again for taking the time earlier. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we can get the right folks aligned: 

1) What we heard: ClearGate is looking to reduce inference cost for your fraud scoring pipelines, preserve sub-150ms tail latency for live scoring, and get SSO + audit logs in place for compliance.

2) Next meeting (technical deep-dive): we'd like to schedule a 60–75 minute session with our solutions engineer to walk through a targeted demo, architecture options (hosted vs dedicated), and an initial security checklist.

3) Stakeholders to loop: security (for data handling / audit logs), procurement (T&Cs and licensing), and platform (network/SSO). Can you please introduce the folks who should attend? If easier, add them on a reply and we’ll coordinate times.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue 6/8 between 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–16:30
- Wed 6/9 between 09:00–11:00

If those don't work, send two preferred slots and we’ll do our best to accommodate. I’ve looped Ben (AM) and Dev (SE) to support scheduling and the session agenda.

Deliverables from Redwood ahead of the call: short pre-read deck (attached), security questionnaire (we can pre-fill common answers) and a proposed draft agenda.

Thanks — Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
